fields.description: What dimension this book budgets against. 'total' means no dimension filter (the rolled-up company budget).
fields.label: Dimension Type

fields.description: The dimension value (e.g. cost center name, project name). Empty for dimension_type=total.
fields.label: Dimension Value

fields.description: User responsible for filling and submitting this book.
fields.label: Owner

fields.description: When checked on the Total book of a report, indicates that this book is the auto-rolled-up sum of all primary-axis books for the same fiscal year.
fields.label: Is Primary Axis Roll-up

fields.description: When checked, the user customized the label and it should not be regenerated from dimension.
fields.label: Label Is Custom
Custom Dimension Fieldname
fields.description: When dimension_type is "custom", this holds the Accounting Dimension fieldname (e.g. "region"). Leave empty for native scopes (total, cost_center, project, department, branch).

fields.label: Basis Year Offset
fields.description: When deriving cells from a prior year, how many years back to look (1 = FY-1, 2 = FY-2, ..., max 5). Only used by the Derive action; doesnt affect saved cells.

fields.label: Default Growth %
fields.description: The default growth percentage applied to basis-year values. e.g. 10 means basis × 1.10. Can be negative for shrink.

fields.label: Per-row growth overrides (JSON)
fields.description: Optional dict mapping row_key → growth%. Section row keys cascade to their source rows unless the source row has its own override. UI-managed; admins normally shouldnt edit by hand.

fields.label: Last Derived At
fields.description: When the Derive action last ran on this book.

fields.label: Cells from Last Derivation
fields.description: How many cells the last Derive action created.
